title: Health data
summary: Workouts, sleep and day metrics from the watch, through Health Connect and Garmin Connect.
description: Health Connect only carries what the Garmin Connect app writes there, so the two are one source arriving twice. Health Connect has data first; Garmin's own numbers are the ones trusted.

stories.as: someone who trains with a Garmin watch
stories.want: my workouts to appear in the diary without logging them
stories.soThat: their calories count without any effort from me

requirements.text: A session from Health Connect enters the diary at once, as provisional.
Once Garmin Connect has a day, an activity or a night, its values replace Health Connect's, and later Health Connect writes leave them alone.
A field the user changed by hand is never overwritten by either source.
A session the user deleted by hand is never imported again.
Imported sessions are matched to existing rows by time, not by the source's record id, so the same session never appears twice.
Health Connect and Garmin imports run only on the phone.
Movement in Health Connect triggers a Garmin sync, if the last one is stale.
